title: mexico sees up 25 economic growth 2027 narrower deficit 2027 budget draft 2026 09 09
text: MEXICO CITY, Sept 8 (Reuters) - Mexico's finance ministry projects economic growth of between 1.5% ​and 2.5% in 2027, while the broader public sector ‌deficit is forecast to narrow to 3.9% of gross domestic product (GDP), according to a draft budget proposal submitted to Congress on Tuesday.
